findings.title: SummarizeConversationNode user-default branch untested
findings.problem: SummarizeConversationNode now prefers resolve_user_default_model() over project resolution (lines 152-158), but tests/codemie/workflows/test_nodes_user_model_override.py covers only ResultFinalizerNode, StateProcessorNode and SummarizeConversationCommandNode. No test constructs SummarizeConversationNode.
findings.impact: If the user-default line is dropped or inverted, summaries would use the project/workflow default instead of the user's override default, possibly a model the user is restricted from, and no test would fail.
findings.recommendation: Add a test building SummarizeConversationNode with workflow_config set, patching ModelAvailabilityService.get_user_override_default_model to return 'user-default', asserting the LLM is created with that model and resolve_model_for_execution is not called; add the inverse case returning None.
